messages:
olivia-partnerships: FYI AetherGrid confirmed availability in apac-east-2: 3 baremetal racks with 4x H100 each (12 GPUs). They want a listing in the cloud marketplace + a joint launch window. Need quick align on quota, KMS/HSM connectivity, and a brief SI integration checklist. Who can take lead?

mina-cloud: I can take the quota flow. Do we have expected baseline RPS and a sizing target for autoscaling?

olivia-partnerships: Partner estimates ~900 RPS aggregate for gen workloads, p50 ~55ms, p95 ~160ms. They recommended colocating KV cache to hit p50. They attached network diagram: https://files.redwood/aethergrid/apac-east2-network.png

sam-eng: Good to know. For p95 160ms we should use the quantized fp8 kernel path. I'll propose runtime profile "aether-apace2-h100". Canary plan: 1 rack (4 GPUs) at 10% traffic -> 30% -> 100%, with rollback gates on error rate and p95.

david-ops: Ops note: baremetal means we need an explicit burst policy; I'm proposing baseline 1 rack, burst to 3 racks. Also need health-probe / graceful-drain hook for the partner's jumpbox ops access.

infra-bot: Quota ticket created: QT-2026-990 (assigned to @mina-cloud). Marketplace draft SKU request ID: SK-5582.

mina-cloud: Submitted portal request (portal 99211) for baseline 1 rack (4 GPUs) with burst to 3. Asked partner to run KMS handshake test (HSM token exchange) and open port 443/1194 for jumpbox. ETA 36h.

nina-legal: Quick flag 12: need to confirm log retention and whether partner will see any ephemeral customer identifiers. Please share the SI integration checklist doc.

olivia-partnerships: Uploaded SI checklist: https://files.redwood/aethergrid/si-checklist.md 12 - highlights: partner ops via bastion + RBAC, logs aggregated to partner-proxy for 14 days, no raw request bodies forwarded.

sam-eng: I'll add a canary manifest in PR #4999. Canary ramps: 10% for 15m, 30% for 30m, then 100% if p95 < 200ms and error rate < 0.5%. Will attach dashboards for kv-cache hit ratio and kernel fallback count.

david-ops: Alerting proposal: p95 > 250ms OR error rate > 1% for 10m -> page oncall. Also add a silent sla slack webhook to #eng-oncall for early signals.

leo-marketing: Marketing wants a joint customer-facing blurb. Target announcement week: May 12. Need partner-approved quote and logo by May 1. Can we commit to that timeline?

mina-cloud: Portal updated: QT-2026-990 -> approved 1743003388. KMS smoke scheduled Mon 08:00 UTC (partner confirmed HSM endpoint).

nina-legal: Reviewing SI checklist, will send 2 small redlines on ops access audit trail by EOD.

olivia-partnerships: Checklist ticklist for launch readiness:
- [ ] Legal signoff (nina-legal)
- [ ] Quota & marketplace SKU (mina-cloud)
- [ ] Runtime PR + canary (sam-eng)
- [ ] Ops alerts + autoscale (david-ops)
- [ ] Marketing assets & partner quote (leo-marketing)
I'll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow 08:30 PT.

sam-eng: Added PR #4999 with runtime profile and canary runbook. Please review.

infra-bot: Marketplace SKU SK-5582 moved to "ready for review".

leo-marketing: :rocket: I'll start a two-paragraph announcement and ping AetherGrid for quote.

nina-legal: Sent redlines to checklist doc, nothing blocking.

olivia-partnerships: Great work team 1- moving to queue for greenlight pending KMS smoke test. Thanks all.
